name: Peak-load feeder/transformer overload
basis: Transformer failures are a recurring BESCOM issue; KERC/BESCOM identify overloading among causes.
Public BESCOM materials document distribution strengthening and feeder-related interventions.
operator_question: How do we relieve overload while keeping critical load online and avoiding a secondary overload?
human_gate: Approve the selected simulated switching/load-change action before execution.

name: Storm-induced cascading failure
basis: Bengaluru storm events have produced transformer failures, snapped lines/poles and large outage volumes.
KERC/BESCOM identify rain/natural calamities as contributors to transformer failures.
operator_question: What is the safest restoration sequence without creating secondary overloads?
human_gate: Approve the restoration sequence before simulated switching.

name: Transformer overheating / oil-condition incident
basis: Published Bengaluru incidents include transformer fires/overheating.
KERC/BESCOM document oil topping, grounding and deteriorated-component replacement.
operator_question: Should the transformer continue, reduce load, isolate, or be replaced?

name: Unsafe re-energization after fault
basis: KERC/BESCOM safety material covers technical audits of 11kV networks, DTCs, LT networks and feeder equipment.
Public Bengaluru incident reporting has highlighted grounding/electrical-safety concerns.
operator_question: Is the circuit actually safe to re-energize?
human_gate: Mandatory human approval for any re-energization.
